name: zkx-live-circuits
description: Circom circuits for zkx-live — Groth16 BN254

scripts.compile: mkdir -p build && circom pay_static.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o build/
scripts.setup: snarkjs groth16 setup build/pay_static.r1cs ptau/pot15_final.ptau build/pay_static_0000.zkey
scripts.vk:export: snarkjs zkey export verificationkey build/pay_static_final.zkey build/pay_static_vk.json
scripts.build:all: npm run compile && npm run info && npm run setup && npm run contribute && npm run vk:export
scripts.prove: snarkjs groth16 fullprove test/input.json build/pay_static_js/pay_static.wasm build/pay_static_final.zkey build/proof.json build/public.json
scripts.verify: snarkjs groth16 verify build/pay_static_vk.json build/public.json build/proof.json
